principles: Only fix the demonstrated correctness issue.
Keep workflow commands host-neutral and agent-neutral.
Prefer narrow, test-proven behavior over broad lifecycle redesign.
Preserve unrelated concurrency and metadata writes.
drivers: Red test proved same-story validate concurrency.
Validate and done_required_validate both write gate evidence.
Long validate commands make accidental concurrent execution expensive.
Formal story should reuse, not rewrite, the proven red/green evidence.

options.name: A: story-scoped validate execution lock
pros: Blocks only the conflicting same-story validate execution path.
cons: Adds one new lock primitive and contention UX.

options.name: B: global validate lock
pros: Simpler lock key and easier reasoning.
cons: Unnecessarily blocks unrelated stories and violates do-not-optimize-arbitrarily.

options.name: C: owner lease only
pros: Would align with broader ownership direction.
cons: Does not directly protect concurrent validate processes in this story and would broaden scope into unfinished lease design.

rationale: Choose the story-scoped validate execution lock because it fixes the proven same-story evidence pollution risk while preserving unrelated concurrency and avoiding a broad owner-lease redesign.

preMortem.scenario: Lock is too broad and slows unrelated work.
preMortem.trigger: Lock key uses project root only instead of story identity.
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke covers different story/worktree parallel validate.

preMortem.scenario: Lock blocks reviewer or delivery metadata writes.
preMortem.trigger: Lock wraps generic story mutations instead of only validate command execution.
preMortem.consequence: REVIEW/DONE evidence lanes become artificially serialized.
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke covers review_pass_set and delivery_check_set while validate is held.

preMortem.trigger: story_advance invokes validate while already in a validate lock context or same process nesting is mishandled.
preMortem.consequence: TEST transition hangs or fails despite valid implementation.
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke covers real story_advance REVIEW to TEST internal validate.

preMortem.consequence: Future validate runs are blocked forever.
preMortem.mitigation: Heartbeat/stale reclaim and smoke coverage for stale lock recovery.
